# Verdant Engine

> Universal 3D browser and WebAssembly game and interface engine in Rust (`crates/verdant-tensor`, `crates/verdant-core`, `crates/verdant-wasm`, `crates/verdant-cli`) mechanized with Prism, twelve unified `uor-matmul` semiring kernels, native WebAssembly `uorc_decompress` + `uor_matmul::codec` zero-decode streaming, Khronos `.glb` scene import and `.glb -> .uorc` transcoding, formal 2D/3D UI compliance, second-order neuromorphic LIF/SSM attention, embedded `coded_gemm` SLM intent routing, and Foundry Prism ID + `afflom/stitch` 2-of-3 parity multiplayer.

## Documentation

- [Verdant Engine documentation](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/): Build verified 3D games, compliant interfaces, and neural worlds for Rust and the web.
- [Build your first 3D world](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/getting-started/): Make a Rust 3D scene, step physics, and test live world focus.
- [Author scenes, UI compliance, and spatial audio](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/guides/custom-game-world/): Import GLB scenes, verify 2D and 3D UI compliance, and step physics with occluded sound.
- [Stream zero-decode scenes and Stitch shards](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/guides/progressive-uorc-streaming/): Decode UORC streams in WebAssembly and shard snapshots across Stitch peers.
- [Verdant Engine API reference](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/reference/engine-api/): Find Rust crates, UI and peer types, CLI flags, and 60fps budgets.
- [Unified semiring tensor core and neuromorphic loop](https://afflom.github.io/verdant-engine/docs/explanation/tensor-and-uorc-streaming/): See how twelve exact math kernels run 3D views, UI, and peer worlds.
